nom: SUNGBOON EDITOR Silk Peptide EGF Intensive Ampoule

avis.titre: I actually think it's doing something
avis.texte: I know that sounds obvious but I've seen a visible difference since I started and that's the highest praise I can give anything. One complaint is it runs out quickly with the amounts you have to use if you're going by the amount specified
Im purchasing my second bottle. I used this along with other peptide products and loved it. Gives tiy Glowy skin

Lots of reviews here focused on the dropper, which I honestly don't think is that bad. It's not great, but it's nowhere near as bad as people are saying. For the actual product, I love it! I've been using this for three weeks now and already see a difference in my skin. For the price, this is an easy buy.
This product had made my skin so soft and even my coworkers are saying that im glowing!

I use this product at night bc I dont like it under makeup, but I use it every night before I go to bed as part of my skincare routine and its really made a difference. Like any skincare routine, you need to stic with it to see results, nothing with any product is an overnight instant makeover - if it was that easy everyone would buy it and do it once. Putting it all over my face at night ad part of my skincare routine along with other products I wake up with my face feeling refreshed, hydrated and plump ready to start the day! The only thing I hate is the packaging, its terrible to use with dropper as part of the lid, so since I just finished the bottle I bought from Ulta, I just bought a bottle direct from the manufacturer on their site bc it's completely different with a separate dropper that looks much easier to use. But the product itself is amazing, but the key is you need to stick with it for the long haul to see the results. I love having glowing youthful skin at 47! Shhhh dont tell anyone my real age bc people think I'm 10-15 years younger but thats bc I'm obsessed with morning and night skincare routines. Thank you to Ulta for having amazing products! And no this isnt a sponsored ad bc I'm just a boring regular person that no one would give anything to, to advertise a product lol
So far, have used for 3 plus weeks and no change in my skin- BUT THE DROPPER delivery system is HORRIBLE- it is hard house- doesnt fill or empty properly
I have received so many compliments on my skin since I started using this. I wash my face, use a toner, then apply.

I lovvveeee this product however its so much better with the syringe. The dropper doesnt pick up any of the gold silks. I think ill order this next time straight from the merchant as the dropper packaging is only at Ulta. So glad i still have my old bottle so I can just transfer it.
My skin is plump, hydrated and glowing. I love this product I just wish the bottle mechanism worked better.
The product itself is great, but I had to return it because the dispenser for the bottle doesn't work. The old packaging was way better.

I've been using this serum for a while now, and it's great. I find that the best way to get product out of the bottle is to first pull the dropper out of the bottle and and push the button to empty it. Then place dropper into bottle (while holding the button) and then let go of the button. It pulls at least 3/4 of the dropper full.

This dispenser is terrible. I love this product and it's original mock syringe dispensing mechanism. But this new mechanism is beyond terrible. I can barely get any product out. I've resorted to pouring it in my hands.
